items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: So okay, we made this record date and Hawkes, had Diz, Clyde Hart on piano, who else was on that date? I Played baritone sax.

ctx.x: Piano player, who was -- I spoke of earlier, was the great arranger and everything. Clyde and I had been doing some writing together, and he says I want you to do something and I'm going to do some things. I want Dizzy to do something, you know,and we're going to make a record date. So okay, we made this record date and Hawkes, had Diz, Clyde Hart on piano, who else was on that date? I Played baritone sax. And any way I played on the date and I did this arrangement, Clyde Hart and myself (unintelligible) called…
